_comment: One environment's settings for the Global Secure Access kit. Copy it once per environment (settings.test.json, settings.production.json), replace every <placeholder>, and file each copy with the change record. Names and IDs only, never a secret: the operator signs in to Microsoft Graph and the Azure CLI as a person, interactively. Read-GsaSettings refuses a secret-like value, and, for test and production, a placeholder left in the file. The commands are the same for test and production; only this file changes. cloud is gcc for Microsoft 365 GCC (Moderate), which uses graph.microsoft.com. Not run against a live tenant.
